candidate_controls.static_behavior: Setup activates to Active; Active suspends or starts archiving; Suspended resumes or starts archiving; Archiving completes to Archived; Archived restores to Suspended.
Timezone, numbering profile and active owner membership are required before activation.
Domain guard rejects a user granting themselves a sensitive role.
Project/location/work/discipline/classification scopes are modeled; scoped reads are routed through candidate policy functions.
Candidate mutation updates membership state and increments user authorization version with refresh-family revocation for relevant changes.
Delegation captures delegatee, scope, actions, validity window and reason; effective-window check exists.
Request/approval/session candidate carries validity, reason and banner information.
Candidate material mutations record audit/outbox data in the same database transaction abstraction.

required_runtime_authorization_tests: Default deny and nonexistent-resource non-disclosure for a user outside the tenant/project.
Cross-tenant role and scope mutation denial.
Suspension/end invalidates server-side authorization and sessions without waiting for the client.
Delegation and break-glass separation-of-duty, date-window, reason, TTL and audit checks.
Transition role, expected-version and state prerequisite checks.
